scenarios.name: dredge-two-replaces-draw-at-boundary
scenarios.why: With at least two cards in the library and Dakmor Salvage in the graveyard, its controller may mill exactly two and return the Salvage to hand instead of drawing.

scenarios.name: not-in-graveyard-does-not-replace-draw
scenarios.why: Dredge functions only while the card is in its owner's graveyard. A copy in hand cannot replace the draw, so the draw occurs and both cards remain in hand.
